title: HR Systems Support Specialist, MEA/EAP
description:
**Company Description**

Doka is a global leader in innovative formwork solutions and services across all areas of construction, and a worldwide supplier of comprehensive scaffolding systems for a broad range of applications. With more than 160 sales and logistics facilities in over 54 countries, Doka provides a high‑performing distribution network that ensures expert advice, customer service and technical support on site, with equipment delivered quickly regardless of project size or complexity. Employing 8,000 people worldwide, Doka is part of the Umdasch Group, a company that has stood for reliability, experience and trustworthiness for more than 150 years and serves as the parent organization for its directly affiliated divisions, including Doka, Umdasch The Store Makers and Umdasch Industrial Solutions.

Established to provide a versatile network of products, systems and expertise, the areas Doka Middle East & Africa and Doka Asia Pacific (APAC) support some of the world’s fastest growing economies. This positions Doka as a strong partner for a wide range of projects, from major infrastructure such as metro systems, bridges and tunnels to cost efficient housing developments. Headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, the Doka MEA and APAC Area teams serve as the central hubs for key functions across the regions and act as links to our headquarters in Austria.

Do you enjoy solving system challenges, helping people get the best out of technology, and improving the way HR works? Are you someone who combines technical curiosity with a passion for delivering an excellent user experience?

We are looking for an **HR Systems Support Specialist** to join our MEA & East Asia Pacific HR team. This newly created role offers the opportunity to work with multiple countries, supporting the rollout, project management, optimisation and day-to-day success of our HR systems while collaborating with colleagues across the region and at our global headquarters.

Working closely with the Area Compensation & Benefits Specialist and our global HR Systems team, you will play an important role in ensuring our HR platforms and projects are reliable, user-friendly and aligned with global standards. Your work will directly support our digitalisation journey and help create a seamless experience for HR teams and employees across the region.

If you enjoy combining technology, problem-solving and collaboration in an international environment—and can confidently train and communicate with stakeholders at all levels, from HR users and country teams to regional and global colleagues—we'd love to hear from you.

This position will be based in India and report to the Head of HR MEA/EAP based in Dubai and work closely with the Compensation & Benefits Specialist MEA/EAP.

 **Job Description**

**WHAT IF your HR systems expertise enhanced the employee experience across MEA & EAP?**

**What you'll be doing**

As our regional HR Systems Support Specialist, you will:

* Provide first-line support and user training for HR systems across the Middle East, Africa and East Asia Pacific, including **SAP HCM, SuccessFactors, SmartRecruiters, Aemlic (former Centric, electronic personnel file)** and **SAP** **Concur (expense management)**.
* Support the planning, coordination and successful implementation of HR system rollouts across multiple countries.
* Help maintain high-quality employee data by ensuring compliance with global standards while supporting local business requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement by listening to user feedback, identifying opportunities to enhance processes and recommending practical solutions within our global framework and considering AI tools and potential / future readiness.
* Maintain and update organisational structures and master data within our HR systems.
* Prepare and deliver standard reports to support HR operations and decision-making.
* Partner closely with the Area Compensation & Benefits Specialist, Global HR Process & Systems team, AI Lead and HR colleagues across the region.
* Analyse system incidents and enhancement requests, providing first-level support and coordinating with the Global HR Systems team for advanced issues.

  
**Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

You are someone who enjoys learning new systems, solving problems and working with people from different cultures and backgrounds. You communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders at all levels, building trust through your approachable style and ability to translate technical topics into practical solutions. You have a structured way of working, pay close attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality support.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or another relevant field.
* At least **5 years' experience** in a similar HR systems support role within an international corporate environment.
* Proven experience supporting HR system implementations, including planning, user training and rollout activities.
* Strong working knowledge of **SAP HCM** or **SuccessFactors (Performance, Goals, Succession, Talent Management, Learning)**; experience with **SmartRecruiters** and **Power BI** would be an advantage.
* Experience providing end-user support and troubleshooting system-related issues.
* Receptive mindset and enthusiastic curiosity towards innovative AI tools and technologies
* A customer-focused, solution-oriented mindset with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling you to build effective relationships and confidently support stakeholders at all organisational levels while balancing local business needs with global standards.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* A collaborative team player who enjoys working in an international, high-performing environment.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why join us?**

This is an opportunity to become part of a global organisation where technology and people come together to improve the employee experience. You'll gain exposure to regional and global HR initiatives, work with modern HR technologies and collaborate with experienced colleagues across multiple countries. If you're looking for a role where you can make a tangible impact while continuing to develop your expertise in HR systems, we'd be excited to welcome you to our team.

title: Data Security Architect
description:
**We are Generac, a leading energy technology company committed to powering a smarter world.**

**Major Responsibilities**
==========================

Architecture & Roadmap:

* Develop and maintain the enterprise data protection reference architecture and multi-year roadmap covering labeling/classification, DLP, insider risk, encryption, tokenization, secure collaboration, and data discovery.

Microsoft Purview Architecture:

* Lead architecture, design, and configuration of Purview Information Protection (sensitivity labels, auto-labeling), Endpoint/Exchange/SharePoint/Teams/OneDrive DLP, Insider Risk, eDiscovery, and Records/Retention.
* Establish policy hierarchies, tuning standards, and exception processes.

Multi-Vendor DLP & DSPM:

* Evaluate, integrate, and/or rationalize additional data security controls (endpoint, network, CASB/SSE, DSPM) for non-Microsoft workloads and high-risk use cases — including platforms such as Varonis, Zscaler, and Cyera. Define control objectives, prevention vs. monitor modes, and rollout sequencing.
* Lead technical evaluations, proof-of-concept design, and success criteria for candidate platforms, and design the integration pattern between DSPM discovery and classification outputs and downstream Purview labeling and DLP enforcement.

Enterprise Platform Security Architecture:

* Design, document, and review data security controls for Generac’s key enterprise platforms, including Salesforce, SAP and SAP HANA, Databricks (including Unity Catalog), Windchill, Workday, and other business-critical SaaS, PaaS, and on-premises systems.

* Serve as the data security architect on platform and integration projects, providing requirements and architectural sign-off through the data security review process.

API & Integration Data Security:

* Define and maintain the security architecture for APIs, middleware, and data integration pipelines that move sensitive data between enterprise platforms, partners, and third parties.
* Establish standards for API authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, signed tokens, service principals), least-privilege scope design, secrets and key management, rate limiting and throttling, payload minimization, field-level masking and tokenization, and encryption in transit. Partner with Integration and Data Engineering teams to review API and pipeline designs for exposure of regulated or sensitive data, define logging and monitoring requirements for API traffic to support detection and investigation, and maintain an inventory of integrations that carry sensitive data along with their control posture.
* Assess third-party and vendor API connections as part of the data security review process.

Data Lifecycle Governance:

* Partner with Data Governance to map critical data elements, owners, systems, and flows.
* Align labeling and retention schedules to regulatory and contractual obligations.

Secure Collaboration & External Sharing:

* Design patterns for secure B2B/B2C collaboration, guest access, and conditional sharing with watermarking, encryption, and expiration.

Detection, Response, and Tuning:

* Define incident workflows for DLP and insider risk alerts.
* Calibrate rules to reduce false positives; implement KPIs and dashboards to measure efficacy and user friction.

Engineering & Automation:

* Partner with M365/Azure engineering to implement at scale.
* Use scripting and APIs (PowerShell/Graph) to automate policy deployment, configuration drift detection, and evidence collection.

Standards & Patterns:

* Author and maintain security standards, reference patterns, and decision records.
* Review projects for adherence; provide architectural sign-off.

Risk & Compliance Alignment:

* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into technical policies; support audits and eDiscovery requests with defensible, repeatable processes.

Change Management & Training:

* Create enablement materials for admins and end users; lead pilots, UAT, and phased rollouts.
* Engage champions to improve adoption and reduce business disruption.

Continuous Improvement

* rive backlog of enhancements.
* Benchmark against peers and industry frameworks.
* Track product releases and threat trends

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science or related field; or equivalent experience.

**Certification/Licenses**

**Work Experience:**

* 7 years in Cybersecurity or IT or combination of 5 years experience and relevant certification Microsoft SC-400 (Information Protection), SC-100/SC-200; CISSP, CIPT or CDPSE

* 3 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Purview / Information Protection / DLP, DSPM, or other enterprise data security platforms.
* Experience designing incident workflows, reporting, and KPI dashboards for DLP/insider risk.
* Hands-on experience with at least one additional DLP/SSE/CASB, DSPM, or endpoint DLP platform (Varonis, Zscaler, Cyera, Symantec/Broadcom, CS Falcon, Forcepoint, Netskope, Skyhigh/Trellix, Proofpoint, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint DLP), including evaluation, proof-of-concept, and integration with a native Microsoft data protection stack.

* Hands-on experience with at least one additional DLP/SSE/CASB, DSPM, or endpoint DLP platform (Varonis, Zscaler, Cyera, Symantec/Broadcom, CS Falcon, Forcepoint, Netskope, Skyhigh/Trellix, Proofpoint, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint DLP), including evaluation, proof-of-concept, and integration with a native Microsoft data protection stack.

title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
description:
**Overview**

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities.

Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities.
* Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features.
* Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management.
* Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership
* Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare.
* Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation.
* Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns.
* Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
* Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance.
* Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose.
* Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues.
* Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
* Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases.
* Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption.

Operational Management

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues.
* Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk.
* Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation.
* Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners.
* Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors.
* Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits.
* Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams.

Governance, Security and Risk

* Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements.
* Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners.
* Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance.
* Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options.
* Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer.

The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous.
* Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI.
* Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support.
* Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes.
* Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous.
* Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation.
* Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review.
* Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including structured diagnosis of complex integration, data, security and configuration issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical options, trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong planning, prioritisation and delivery discipline, with the ability to manage concurrent initiatives and production priorities.
* High standards of integrity, discretion and care when handling employee and organisational data.
* Practical, collaborative and outcomes-focused, with the confidence to work with limited supervision, manage multiple priorities, challenge weak assumptions and escalate material risks.

title: Looking for Personal Secretary
description:
Roles and Responsibilities are as follows -

1. Answering Calls, Taking Messages, and Handling Correspondence

Secretaries serve as the first point of contact for clients, partners, and internal teams. They manage phone lines, direct inquiries, screen calls, and ensure that communications are documented and followed up on promptly. This ensures professionalism and responsiveness in all external and internal interactions.

2. Maintaining Diaries and Arranging Appointments

Efficient time management is essential for leadership and team coordination. Secretaries manage calendars, schedule meetings, and avoid conflicts to ensure productivity. They act as gatekeepers, allowing executives to focus on strategic responsibilities without administrative overload.

3. Typing, Preparing, and Collating Reports

Whether it's drafting letters, writing proposals, or compiling performance reports, secretaries play a central role in the production of professional documents. They ensure accuracy, formatting consistency, and timely delivery of materials used in decision-making processes.

4. Filing and Documentation

Organizing physical and digital records is a critical administrative function. Secretaries maintain secure, well-structured systems that ensure quick access to important documents and compliance with information governance policies.

5. Organizing and Servicing Meetings

From scheduling and setting up meeting rooms to preparing agendas and recording minutes, secretaries are key to effective meeting management. Their detailed notes help ensure clear follow-up and accountability on action points.

6. Managing Databases

A secretary often manages databases containing client details, vendor records, or HR information. This includes regular updates, data integrity checks, and sometimes analysis, making sure that critical information is accurate and accessible when needed.

7. Prioritizing Workloads

With multiple responsibilities competing for attention, secretaries must constantly assess and adjust priorities. They juggle urgent tasks, manage time-sensitive deadlines, and support team members in optimizing their schedules.

8. Implementing New Procedures and Administrative Systems

Secretaries often identify opportunities for administrative improvements. Whether it’s transitioning to cloud-based systems, digitizing records, or streamlining workflows, they help implement smarter ways of working across departments.

9. Liaising with Relevant Organizations and Clients

Communication with external stakeholders is a key part of the role. Secretaries coordinate with vendors, clients, and partners, ensuring all interactions are professional, timely, and aligned with business goals.

10. Coordinating Mail-shots and Similar Publicity Tasks

Supporting marketing or outreach functions, some administrators assist in the distribution of newsletters, promotional materials, and public announcements. This often involves working with CRM tools or mailing platforms to maintain contact lists.

11. Logging or Processing Bills and Expenses

Financial support tasks such as tracking departmental expenses, processing payments, and managing petty cash often fall under a secretary’s remit. Their attention to detail ensures financial accuracy and proper reporting.

12. Acting as a Receptionist and Greeting Clients

In many organizations, secretaries also manage front-desk duties. They provide a warm welcome to visitors, manage guest logs, and maintain a professional office atmosphere while balancing their administrative tasks.

13. Recruiting, Supervising, and Training Junior Staff

**About the Role**

Operating across** **all core business domains** **(e.g., Customer, Supplier, Item, Product, Equipment, HR, Finance, Commercial, Operations, …), you will design, develop, and maintain high\-performing Logical Data Models (LDM) and Physical Data Models (PDM) that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational applications.**

**You will translate diverse cross\-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Logical \& Physical Data Model Design:**


	+ **Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and** **Logical Data Models (LDM)** **across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.**
	+ **Translate LDMs into optimized** **Physical Data Models (PDM)** **tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.**
	+ **Reverse\-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.**
	+ **Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity\-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.**
* **Domain Alignment \& Standards Governance:**


	+ **Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.**
	+ **Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.**
	+ **Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross\-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.**
* **Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration:**


	+ **Work hand\-in\-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.**
	+ **Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.**
	+ **Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.**
* **Model Optimization \& Quality:**


	+ **Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.**
	+ **Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.**

**Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** **focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.**
* **Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity\-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.**
* **Strong proficiency in** **SQL** **for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.**
* **Hands\-on experience with modern** **cloud data warehouses** **(preferably** **GCP BigQuery****, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.**
* **Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).**
* **Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.**
* **Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.**

**Preferred Skills**

* **Experience with** **Data Vault 2\.0** **modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.**
* **Exposure to real\-time or streaming data modeling patterns (Event\-driven architectures).**
* **Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).**
* **Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.**
